_evidence_source: synthetic: combines manufactured urgency and irreversible-payment insistence together, modeled on the FTC-documented pattern where both pressure tactics are used in the same imposter-scam call (see references/scam-red-flags.md)

call.task: Verify a flagged $5,400 gift-card transaction to an unverified 'utility payment processor'.
call.summary: Account holder reported being told her power would be shut off within the hour unless she paid by gift card immediately.

attempts.summary: Account holder confirmed both urgency and irreversible-payment demand.

transcript_turns.speaker: bot

transcript_turns.text: Can you describe your relationship to the recipient?

transcript_turns.text: They said they were from the utility company, but it's not the number I usually call.

transcript_turns.text: Were you asked to pay by wire, gift card, or cryptocurrency specifically?
